name: Virginia

rule.textEn: Every operator of a motorboat with a 10 hp or larger engine, whatever the age, and every PWC operator must carry a boating safety course card.
rule.textEs: Todo operador de una lancha con motor de 10 hp o más, de cualquier edad, y todo operador de moto acuática debe llevar la tarjeta de un curso de seguridad náutica.

minAge.note: No PWC under 14; at 14-15 proof of an approved course (not the challenge exam) is required.

exemptions: US Coast Guard master, captain or mate license.
Boat registered in another state whose owner meets the home-state requirement.

card.nameEn: Boating safety education card (Virginia Lifetime Boater's Card available)

nonResident: Boats registered in another state: the home-state education rule applies.

sources.quote: All PWC operators age 14 and older and all operators (regardless of age) of motorboats with a 10 hp or greater engine need to take a boating safety course.
No person under the age of 14 may operate a PWC.
No – If you are operating a boat registered in another state if you meet the applicable boating safety education requirements of your state of residency.
